name: DataTable
description: Server-side sorting and pages, columns that fold by priority into “+N” and then cards, resizable and pinned columns, bulk actions and live rows.

props.name: actions
props.description:
The entity's actions (R12). The row ⋯ menu, the right-click menu and the bulk bar are
the shared action renderers reading this one definition, so they match ActionMenu,
ActionContextMenu and every other surface.

props.name: cardBreakpoint
props.description: Below this width (rem) rows become cards (default 36).

props.name: className
props.description: Classes applied to the outer element for layout. Use the component props and theme tokens for its appearance.

props.name: columns
props.description: Typed column definitions, including rendering, sorting, priorities and filters.

props.name: cursor
props.description: Switch the pager to cursor mode.

props.name: defaultState
props.description: Initial uncontrolled view state.

props.name: density
props.description: Row density for this table. Uncontrolled tables persist the user's choice.

props.name: emptyAction
props.description: The primary action for the unfiltered empty state ("Enrol a device").

props.name: emptyMessage
props.description:
One line for an empty result with nothing searched or filtered (R2.5): "No endpoints
enrolled". While searching or filtering the table says so itself (`No devices match
"orb-7" and 2 filters`) and offers Clear search and Clear filters instead.

props.name: error
props.description: Shown in the body box with Retry. A string should say what failed and what to do.

props.name: filterToggles
props.description:
On/off filters that are not a column ("Show hidden"): rows in the Filters menu, and a
chip while on. Clear filters turns them off too.

props.name: getRowActions
props.description:
Per-row ActionSets, for rows of different kinds (a device list: an endpoint's set is not a
printer's). It replaces `actions`. One row's ⋯ and right-click resolve its own set, so
they match its header exactly. A selection of several kinds (right-click inside it, the
bulk bar) offers the actions every kind's set resolves, bulk in each, and each kind runs
its own definition against its own rows (`resolveRowActions`). Keep the sets stable: the
same object for every row of a kind.

props.name: getRowId
props.description: Returns a stable row identifier for selection, live updates and preferences.

props.name: getRowLabel
props.description: Accessible label for a row ("NST-C106"). Defaults to the first column's text.

props.name: grouping
props.description:
Group the rows (server-side, docs/data-filters.md §7): a header row per group with its
count from the server, which collapses (click, Enter or Space; ← and → on the header;
Alt-click toggles every group). Each expanded group shows its first `pageSize` rows and
a "Show more" line while the server has more; the pager gives way to a count. The
collapsed groups and "Show more" counts are the `groups` state slice (in the URL with
`useTableUrlState({ grouped: true })`). Pass `rows` in group order: each expanded
group's loaded rows, as `groupOf` assigns them.

props.name: height
props.description: "fill" (default) fills a parent with a definite height and scrolls inside.

props.name: id
props.description: Stable id: persists column widths, hidden columns, pins and density per user.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name of the grid, e.g. "Endpoints".

props.name: live
props.description: Live data: flash changed cells and hold new rows behind an "N new" pill.

props.name: loading
props.description: First load: skeleton rows in the final shape.

props.name: noun
props.description: Noun for counts in the status bar ("1,284 endpoints").

props.name: onAction
props.type: ((action: ResolvedAction<T>, targets: readonly T[], surface: ActionSurface) => void) | undefined
props.description:
Run actions yourself. By default every surface uses the shared runner: confirm in an
AlertDialog, run, then report with a toast (R12.4, R12.5). With `onAction`, the
confirmation and the feedback are the caller's.

props.name: onDensityChange
props.description: Called when density change occurs. The callback type specifies its arguments.

props.name: onRetry
props.description: Called when retry occurs. The callback type specifies its arguments.

props.name: onRowOpen
props.description: Enter or double-click on a row.

props.name: onStateChange
props.description: Called with the next full state and the slice that changed.

props.name: pageSizes
props.description: Page-size choices offered by pagination.

props.name: queryKey
props.description:
Identity of the query behind `rows` (scope, view, anything outside the table's state).
When it changes the rows are a new result; when it does not, changed rows are live
updates and flash. Sorting, the search, filters and the page are part of it already.

props.name: refetching
props.description: A refetch is in flight: rows stay, a thin line runs under the header.

props.name: renderBulkActions
props.description: Replace the bulk bar's action buttons.

props.name: renderRowActions
props.description: Replace the ⋯ menu for a row (render your own trigger, e.g. a shared ActionMenu).

props.name: renderRowContextMenu
props.description:
Replace the context menu's content for a row (or the selection it belongs to). It is
placed inside the shared ContextMenu popup, so build it from Menu parts.

props.name: rowCount
props.description: Total rows on the server (offset pagination).

props.name: rows
props.description: The current page of rows, already sorted and paged by the server.

props.name: rowWrapper
props.description: Wrap each row element (e.g. in the shared ActionContextMenu). Must render `children`.

props.name: search
props.description:
The toolbar search (R16.8): a field at the start of the toolbar, beside Filters, that
matches these identifying fields on the server. Its query is the `search` state slice
(`q` in the URL with useTableUrlState). Typing waits 220 ms, then returns to the first
page. `/` focuses it while the table has focus. On a narrow toolbar it is an icon
button that opens the field, and an active query shows as a "Search: …" chip.

props.name: selectable
props.description: Show checkboxes and allow selection (default true).

props.name: state
props.description: Controlled slices. A slice left out is owned by the table.

props.name: status
props.description: Extra status bar content (connection state, last sync).

props.name: toolbar
props.description: The table's own controls (a view switch, Refresh), at the end of the toolbar.

props.name: updatedAt
props.description: When the data was last refreshed (status bar: "Updated 2 min ago").
